    directoryState: $directoryState
    directoryType: $directoryType
    auditLogStreamType: $auditLogStreamType

    environmentId: $environmentId
    hasDataIntegrations: $hasDataIntegrations
    hasOrganizationAdmin: $hasOrganizationAdmin
    limit: $limit
    rangeEnd: $rangeEnd
    rangeStart: $rangeStart
    search: $search
    sortField: $sortField
    order: $order
    usersCountMaximum: $usersCountMaximum
    usersCountMinimum: $usersCountMinimum
  ) {
    data {
      ...Organization
    }
    listMetadata {
      before

    }
  }
}
